connector.name: Outris Identity MCP
connector.registryDescription: Identity resolution MCP server for phone/email lookups across 31+ services. Global + India coverage.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp-server.outris.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the outris-dev-user account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for authentication. Get your API key at https://portal.outris.com
